tag.vi: 🦶⏱️ Làm chân: mai đi công tác

occasion: You fly out for a work trip tomorrow morning and want neat, clean feet. You are short on time.
constraints: A classic pedicure, no colour (nude or clear), square and short. You ask how long it takes and the price before you sit. You appreciate clear answers and a stylist who keeps the steps moving.
openingLine: Hi. I need a quick pedicure, just clean and neat. How long does it take?
